Vipshop Hldgs LTD (VIPS) Shareholder Mirae Asset Global Investments Lifted Holding by $101.48 Million
July 13, 2018 - By Paula Hilliard
Mirae Asset Global Investments increased its stake in Vipshop Hldgs Ltd (VIPS) by 250.55% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mirae Asset Global Investments bought 6.34 million shares as the company’s stock declined 35.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 8.87 million shares of the catalog and specialty distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $147.48 million, up from 2.53M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mirae Asset Global Investments who had been investing in Vipshop Hldgs Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.92% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $10.23. About 4.87M shares traded. Vipshop Holdings Limited (NYSE:VIPS) has declined 10.11% since July 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.68% the S&P500.
Mirae Asset Global Investments, which manages about $4.74 billion and $7.64B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Schwab Strategic Tr (SCHB) by 753,100 shares to 848,136 shares, valued at $54.10M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 142,788 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 547,379 shares, and cut its stake in Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA).
More news for Vipshop Holdings Limited (NYSE:VIPS) were recently published by: Benzinga.com , which released: “Goldman Sachs Downgrades Vipshop, Says Other Chinese Internet Picks Hold More Upside Potential” on July 11, 2018. Seekingalpha.com ‘s article titled: “Vipshop Holdings: Trade War Headwinds And Margin Compression” and published on July 03, 2018 is yet another important article.
